source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
WHS_UNIID,
WHS_CTG_CD,
WHS_CTG_DES_C,
WHS_CTG_DES_E,
[WHS_STA_DT],
[WHS_END_DT],
DATEADD(HH,8,getdate())
FROM [MVIEW].[MDM_WHS_MST_MV]

select 
'Num' as Num,
'Billing_Type_Cd' as Billing_Type_Cd ,
'Fiscal_Year' as   Fiscal_Year,
'Posting_Period' as    Posting_Period,
'Soldto_Cust_UniId' as   Soldto_Cust_UniId,
'Soldto_Cust_Cd' as   Soldto_Cust_Cd ,
'Invoice_Dt' as   Invoice_Dt ,
'Company_Cd' as   Company_Cd ,
'SalesOrg_Cd' as SalesOrg_Cd  ,
'DistChannel_Cd' as DistChannel_Cd   ,
'Billing_Document_Id' as  Billing_Document_Id ,
'Document_Currency' as  Document_Currency ,
'Payer_Cust_UniId' as Payer_Cust_UniId ,
'Payer_Cust_Cd' as   Payer_Cust_Cd  ,
'PO_Number' as PO_Number ,
'Sales_Document_Id' as  Sales_Document_Id ,
'Order_Type_Cd' as   Order_Type_Cd ,
'Reason_Cd' as Reason_Cd ,
'Billing_Item' as Billing_Item ,
'Product_UniId' as    Product_UniId ,
'Product_Sku_Cd' as  Product_Sku_Cd  ,
'Product_Type_Cd' as  Product_Type_Cd ,
'Product_Type_Nm' as   Product_Type_Nm,
'Item_Category_Cd' as  Item_Category_Cd,
'Exchange_Rate' as   Exchange_Rate  ,
'Invoice_Qty' as  Invoice_Qty ,
'Uom_of_Sales' as  Uom_of_Sales,
'Invoice_Qty_Cs' as  Invoice_Qty_Cs  ,
'Net_Value_Local_Currency' as  Net_Value_Local_Currency  ,
'Net_Value_Billing_Document' as Net_Value_Billing_Document  ,
'Net_Weight' as Net_Weight  ,
'Grs_Weight' as   Grs_Weight ,
'Volume' as  Volume ,
'Uom_of_vol' as  Uom_of_vol  ,
'Net_Vol_L' as  Net_Vol_L,
'Tax_Value' as Tax_Value ,
'GPS' as  GPS  ,
'GPS_Local' as  GPS_Local,
'GPR' as GPR   ,
'NPS' as    NPS,
'DC_UniId' as   DC_UniId,
'DC_Cd' as DC_Cd ,
'Storage_Location' as Storage_Location ,
'Shipping_Point_Cd' as  Shipping_Point_Cd ,
'Shipto_Cust_UniId' as  Shipto_Cust_UniId ,
'Shipto_Cust_Cd' as   Shipto_Cust_Cd ,
'Route_Cd' as  Route_Cd ,
'Local_Sales_Chl' as   Local_Sales_Chl,
'Nestle_Sales_Chl_Cd' as  Nestle_Sales_Chl_Cd ,
'Creation_Tm_GMT' as  Creation_Tm_GMT ,
'Reference_Document' as Reference_Document ,
'Cancel_Status_Cd' as Cancel_Status_Cd ,
'Billto_Cust_UniId' as   Billto_Cust_UniId,
'Billto_Cust_Cd' as   Billto_Cust_Cd ,
'File_Dt' as File_Dt ,
'Pub_Dt' as   Pub_Dt,
'Week_Id' as  Week_Id,
'Source' as   Source,
'Ledger_Period' as  Ledger_Period   ,
'Prod_Type_Cd' as Prod_Type_Cd ,
'Post_CL6_Cd' as  Post_CL6_Cd ,
'Post_CL5_Cd' as  Post_CL5_Cd ,
'Post_CL4_Cd' as  Post_CL4_Cd ,
'Post_CL3_Cd' as   Post_CL3_Cd,
'Reference_Id' as Reference_Id ,
'Cust_Chl_Cd' as  Cust_Chl_Cd ,
'Creation_Tm' as  Creation_Tm ,
'Cust_Surcharge' as  Cust_Surcharge  ,
'Etl_Tm' as   Etl_Tm,
'Etl_Src' as  Etl_Src
union all
select 
str(Num) as Num,
Billing_Type_Cd ,
    cast(Fiscal_Year as nvarchar) as Fiscal_Year   ,
     cast(Posting_Period  as nvarchar) as  Posting_Period,
    Soldto_Cust_UniId ,
    Soldto_Cust_Cd,
    cast(Invoice_Dt  as nvarchar) as   Invoice_Dt    ,
    Company_Cd      ,
    SalesOrg_Cd     ,
    DistChannel_Cd  ,
    Billing_Document_Id ,
    Document_Currency ,
    Payer_Cust_UniId,
    Payer_Cust_Cd   ,
    PO_Number,
    Sales_Document_Id ,
    Order_Type_Cd   ,
    Reason_Cd,
    Billing_Item    ,
    Product_UniId   ,
    Product_Sku_Cd  ,
    Product_Type_Cd ,
    Product_Type_Nm ,
    Item_Category_Cd,
    cast(Exchange_Rate as nvarchar) as Exchange_Rate  ,
     cast(Invoice_Qty as nvarchar) as  Invoice_Qty   ,
    Uom_of_Sales    ,
     cast(Invoice_Qty_Cs as nvarchar) as Invoice_Qty_Cs ,
     cast(Net_Value_Local_Currency as nvarchar) as   Net_Value_Local_Currency,
     cast(Net_Value_Billing_Document as nvarchar) as Net_Value_Billing_Document,
     cast(Net_Weight  as nvarchar) as   Net_Weight  ,
     cast(Grs_Weight as nvarchar) as   Grs_Weight   ,
     cast(Volume  as nvarchar) as Volume,
    Uom_of_vol,
     cast(Net_Vol_L as nvarchar) as Net_Vol_L,
     cast(Tax_Value as nvarchar) as Tax_Value,
     cast(GPS as nvarchar) as GPS ,
     cast(GPS_Local as nvarchar) as GPS_Local,
     cast(GPR as nvarchar) as GPR ,
     cast(NPS as nvarchar) as  NPS,
    DC_UniId ,
    DC_Cd,
    Storage_Location,
    Shipping_Point_Cd ,
    Shipto_Cust_UniId ,
    Shipto_Cust_Cd  ,
    Route_Cd ,
    Local_Sales_Chl ,
    Nestle_Sales_Chl_Cd ,
    cast(Creation_Tm_GMT as nvarchar) as Creation_Tm_GMT ,
    Reference_Document,
    Cancel_Status_Cd,
    Billto_Cust_UniId ,
    Billto_Cust_Cd  ,
     cast(File_Dt as nvarchar) as File_Dt,
     cast(Pub_Dt as nvarchar) as Pub_Dt,
     cast(Week_Id as nvarchar) as Week_Id,
    Source ,
     cast(Ledger_Period  as nvarchar) as   Ledger_Period,
    Prod_Type_Cd    ,
    Post_CL6_Cd     ,
    Post_CL5_Cd     ,
    Post_CL4_Cd     ,
    Post_CL3_Cd     ,
    Reference_Id    ,
    Cust_Chl_Cd     ,
     cast(Creation_Tm as nvarchar) as  Creation_Tm ,
     cast(Cust_Surcharge as nvarchar) as Cust_Surcharge ,
     cast(Etl_Tm as nvarchar) as Etl_Tm,
    Etl_Src
 from (
select  row_number() over(order by Billing_Type_Cd ) as Num,
*
from(
select 
Billing_Type_Cd ,
    cast(Fiscal_Year as nvarchar) as Fiscal_Year   ,
     cast(Posting_Period  as nvarchar) as  Posting_Period,
    Soldto_Cust_UniId ,
    Soldto_Cust_Cd,
    cast(Invoice_Dt  as nvarchar) as   Invoice_Dt    ,
    Company_Cd      ,
    SalesOrg_Cd     ,
    DistChannel_Cd  ,
    Billing_Document_Id ,
    Document_Currency ,
    Payer_Cust_UniId,
    Payer_Cust_Cd   ,
    PO_Number,
    Sales_Document_Id ,
    Order_Type_Cd   ,
    Reason_Cd,
    Billing_Item    ,
    Product_UniId   ,
    Product_Sku_Cd  ,
    Product_Type_Cd ,
    Product_Type_Nm ,
    Item_Category_Cd,
    cast(Exchange_Rate as nvarchar) as Exchange_Rate  ,
     cast(cast(Invoice_Qty as decimal(12, 4)) as nvarchar) as  Invoice_Qty   ,
    Uom_of_Sales    ,
     cast(cast(Invoice_Qty_Cs as decimal(12, 4)) as nvarchar) as Invoice_Qty_Cs ,
     cast(cast(Net_Value_Local_Currency  as decimal(19, 6)) as nvarchar) as   Net_Value_Local_Currency,
     cast(cast(Net_Value_Billing_Document   as decimal(19, 6)) as nvarchar) as Net_Value_Billing_Document,
     cast(cast(Net_Weight  as decimal(12, 4))  as nvarchar) as   Net_Weight  ,
     cast(cast(Grs_Weight   as decimal(12, 4)) as nvarchar) as   Grs_Weight   ,
     cast(cast(Volume as decimal(12, 4)) as nvarchar) as Volume,
    Uom_of_vol,
     cast(cast(Net_Vol_L  as decimal(12, 4)) as nvarchar) as Net_Vol_L,
     cast(cast(Tax_Value as decimal(19, 6))  as nvarchar) as Tax_Value,
     cast(cast(GPS  as decimal(19, 6)) as nvarchar) as GPS ,
     cast(cast(GPS_Local  as decimal(19, 6)) as nvarchar) as GPS_Local,
     cast(cast(GPR  as decimal(19, 6)) as nvarchar) as GPR ,
     cast(cast(NPS  as decimal(19, 6)) as nvarchar) as  NPS,
    DC_UniId ,
    DC_Cd,
    Storage_Location,
    Shipping_Point_Cd ,
    Shipto_Cust_UniId ,
    Shipto_Cust_Cd  ,
    Route_Cd ,
    Local_Sales_Chl ,
    Nestle_Sales_Chl_Cd ,
    cast(Creation_Tm_GMT as nvarchar) as Creation_Tm_GMT ,
    Reference_Document,
    Cancel_Status_Cd,
    Billto_Cust_UniId ,
    Billto_Cust_Cd  ,
     cast(File_Dt as nvarchar) as File_Dt,
     cast(Pub_Dt as nvarchar) as Pub_Dt,
     cast(Week_Id as nvarchar) as Week_Id,
    Source ,
     cast(Ledger_Period  as nvarchar) as   Ledger_Period,
    Prod_Type_Cd    ,
    Post_CL6_Cd     ,
    Post_CL5_Cd     ,
    Post_CL4_Cd     ,
    Post_CL3_Cd     ,
    Reference_Id    ,
    Cust_Chl_Cd     ,
     cast(Creation_Tm as nvarchar) as  Creation_Tm ,
     cast(Cust_Surcharge as nvarchar) as Cust_Surcharge ,
     cast(Etl_Tm as nvarchar) as Etl_Tm,
    Etl_Src
 from  NESZ_BFL.SI_Sales
where SalesOrg_Cd in('CN23','CN14') and DistChannel_Cd='01'
--and Ledger_Period=format(dateadd(DD,0,getdate()),'yyyyMM')
and Ledger_Period>=format(dateadd(MM,-1,getdate()),'yyyyMM')
)a
)t
